notes.title: Now with 250 Voices, Fewer Hugs, and Less Peeing!
notes.content:
[p][b]⚙️ Patch Notes for [i]Sexuality in Ancient Rome[/i] – Now with 250 Voices, Fewer Hugs, and Less Peeing! 🇮🇹💦[/b][/p][p]Citizens of Rome, rejoice (or at least stop hugging strangers)! We've just rolled out a major update based on your feedback, awkward bug reports, and one passionate email about "boob realism."[/p][h3]🔧 New Settings in the Main Menu:[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Life Cycle Toggle[/b]
Don’t want your character to get sleepy, desperate for a piss, or generally act like a human? No problem! Now you can turn off the life cycle completely. The widget disappears, and your avatar becomes a tireless, bladderless Roman god.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Voice-Off for the Main Player[/b]
Sick of your character's monologues about ancient pleasures? Mute them entirely. Sweet silence shall reign in the Forum.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest System Toggle[/b]
Don’t want purpose in life? Perfect. Turn off the quest system and wander Rome without goals—just like a true philosopher.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Anti-Hug Mode[/b]
Tired of spontaneous AI affection? Now you can disable hugs altogether. AI will keep their hands to themselves and treat you with cold, stoic Roman indifference.[/p][/*][/olist][h3]🗣️ Wardrobe Update: 250 Voices in 39 Languages[/h3][p]Want your Roman orgy to sound like it's being narrated by a Swedish opera singer or a Brazilian barista? You're in luck! Customize voices for your character, AI, and NPCs from over 250 options. From Latin whispers to German enthusiasm, your ancient debauchery has never sounded so… diverse.[/p][h3]🧭 New Controls for Lefties[/h3][p]Left-handed folks, we see you. You can now move your character with arrow keys and Right Shift like a proper rebel against WASD tyranny.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Bug Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]AI no longer forgets how to animate—expect smoother moves and less T-pose terror.[/p][/*][*][p]Graphics and DLSS settings now remember your choices like a loyal scribe.[/p][/*][*][p]Male boob size has been [i]definitely[/i] fixed. We apologize to anyone who had questions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bizarre bug where every sex or pee attempt triggered the same animation and froze your movement. Rome wasn’t built on monotony.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]More updates soon, and as always: stay historically inappropriate. 🏛️❤️[/b][/p]
